environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task behind CloudFront distribution with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes rule group reference statement to 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' with SizeRestrictions_BODY action override set to COUNT (not block), and a separate custom rule with priority 1 that inspects the multipart form field name using a regex pattern match on the 'filename' header parameter within Content-Disposition, blocking requests where the filename contains characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9._-] with a 403 response. Additionally, the container's ECS task definition specifies 'readonlyRootFilesystem: true' with an explicit volume mount for /tmp configured as an EFS access point with POSIX permissions uid=1000/gid=1000 and root directory creation permissions disabled. The container USER directive is set to 1000:1000 (non-root). The EFS access point enforces that all file operations occur as uid 1000 regardless of the requesting process identity.

config.waf_web_acl: CloudFront + WAFv2 with custom filename regex rule priority 1
config.tmp_mount: EFS access point, uid=1000, gid=1000, root directory creation disabled
config.efs_posix_permissions: enforced uid 1000 for all operations, no symlink to paths outside /tmp possible
